articles.title: Coachella 2027: Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala to Headline
articles.summary: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA will headline Coachella 2027, with Madonna, Daddy Yankee, and dozens more on the bill.

articles.title: VisionQuest Finale Finally Wraps Up Ultron's Story
articles.summary: The 'VisionQuest' finale settles a story that began in 2015's 'Avengers: Age of Ultron' — with a final showdown, and a surprising lesson about love.

articles.title: Olympic Swim Star Tatjana Smith Switches to the Netherlands
articles.summary: Tatjana Smith, South Africa's most decorated Olympian, will swim for the Netherlands after coming out of retirement.
